description: Second turn on the same thread via `codex exec resume`. Same thread_id as exec_success; context was retained.
argv: what single word did you just reply? answer with only that word
notes: `codex exec resume` has NO -C/--cd, -p/--profile or -s/--sandbox: the working directory must come from the process cwd
item ids restart at item_0 in every process; they are not unique across segments
thread_id in thread.started equals the requested id — callers MUST compare them
